subject: refactor(material/autocomplete): switch tests away from fakeAsync (#33105)

hunk_reviews.rationale: Decline this private autocomplete scheduler/fixture migration. Its complete original pairs182 cases and11 hooks while explicitly deleting one fakeAsync-specific active-item execution case; legacy owned fake/sync activity tests remain. Four exact cases convert six fixed-array forEach loops into awaited for-of iterations: the27 action values/order/bodies and predicates are checked separately, with no microtask/frame/lifecycle equivalence claim. The no-panel case removes an explicit nonthrow observer. An OnPush fixture converts its plain array and template to a signal/options() and .set assignment; its1000ms timer persists, while the panel-visible case uses a1500ms native wait and moves the Promise.then assertion inline. Preserve the owned plain-array/*ngFor fixture, explicit no-panel observer, source tests, public integration and Material16 structure/style. Cyph legacy autocomplete remains reachable. No product/consumer template/style/API port follows from these private fixture changes; actual application/native/geometry/floor gates remain required.
